name: Mooncut Masjid
summary: A rounded mosque carries a crescent cut directly into its broad dome, balanced by one attached minaret.
why: The round dome and entrance share x50. A true crescent opening sits within the upper dome mass, leaving structural wall all around it. The minaret is physically joined through the hall and an attached balcony collar; the entire crescent remains open in a one-color version.
risk: The carved moon is deliberately bold and abstract. Its crescent becomes subtler at the smallest icon size, while the mosque outline remains.

palette.name: MOONCUT MASJID / STONE + IVORY + WARM METAL

reasonToChoose: You want a clear mosque with its Islamic night motif held inside the building.
